tips.title: Define measurement system and storage directories
tips.body: Configure hyperMILL to use Metric/Inch units and set project-specific directories for storing generated files.

tips.title: Set up workpiece origin and frame(s)
tips.body: Establish a connection to the machine coordinate system using an origin reference system and define machining sides and directions.

tips.title: Define tool parameters
tips.body: Create a new tool or apply an existing tool from the database in hyperMILL.

tips.title: Prepare manufacturing geometry
tips.body: Use both 2D contours and CAD models for 2D machining, and a CAD model for 3D and 5-axis jobs.

tips.title: Structure CAM project
tips.body: Define job and job list, use compound jobs to structure the workflow within a job list.

tips.title: Collision check preparations
tips.body: Specify milling or turning areas to define the collision-checked part of the CAD model.

tips.title: Calculate and analyse toolpaths
tips.body: Calculate toolpaths directly in the job definition or via hyperMILL browser, and analyse them using hyperCAD-S.

tips.title: Simulate machining and generate NC program
tips.body: Simulate machining using internal simulation, machine simulation, hyperVIEW, or an external simulation program.

tips.title: Use Project Assistant for project creation
tips.body: Utilize the Project Assistant to create a milling or MillTurn project in a predefined sequence of steps.

tips.title: Define model and machining technology
tips.body: Select milling or MillTurn technology, choose surfaces or solids for machining, and define stock resolution.

tips.title: Define NCS orientation for milling
tips.body: Set the orientation of the NCS using Workplane, Surface, or 3 Points, and reverse the Z axis direction if necessary.

tips.title: Define NCS orientation for MillTurn
tips.body: Set the orientation of the NCS using Workplane, Surface, or Line, and reverse the Z axis direction if necessary.

tips.title: Define stock size and allowances for milling
tips.body: Calculate the stock size automatically from defined offsets in X, Y, and Z directions.

tips.title: Define stock size and allowances for MillTurn
tips.body: Calculate the stock size automatically from defined offsets in Z and radial offset.

tips.title: Define NCS position for milling
tips.body: Select a predefined basic position or define a user-defined position relative to the model or stock.

tips.title: Define NCS position for MillTurn
tips.body: Select a predefined basic position or define a user-defined position relative to the model or stock.

tips.title: Define machining frames
tips.body: Create orthogonal frames for each machining side relative to the model or stock, and set global clearance plane height.

tips.title: Define names, select material and machine
tips.body: Finalize setup by defining joblist, milling/turning area, stock name, and selecting material and machine.

tips.title: Define NC system alignment
tips.body: Align NC system with world workplane before defining joblist.

tips.title: Set frame for multi-axis indexing
tips.body: Define a frame for each machining side in multi-axis indexing.

tips.title: Adjust frame for collision checking
tips.body: Frames share responsibility for collision checking during machining.

tips.title: Define frame origin and orientation
tips.body: Use the Define frame dialogue to set frame origin, orientation, and clamping position.

tips.title: Modify frame origin and orientation
tips.body: Change the frame origin or project the coordinate system in the direction of X, Y, Z axis.

tips.title: Use associative workplane in hyperMILL
tips.body: Activate Parametric Modelling, select Frame or Origin, and activate Associative workplane function.

tips.title: Update clamping position in joblist
tips.body: Use Update clamping position function to update jobs after changes to the clamping position.

tips.title: Apply macro function for hole feature assignment
tips.body: Use Frame limit dialogue page to automatically assign jobs with hole features based on direction.

tips.title: Define frame limit for hole features
tips.body: Specify permissible maximum angle range for A/B and C axes in selected coordinate system.

tips.title: Create zero points for NC output
tips.body: Define multiple origins and assign them to jobs in hyperMILL job list settings.

tips.title: Transfer NC tool from external database to hyperMILL
tips.body: Select an NC tool from the OPEN MIND tool database and transfer it to hyperMILL using the Transfer to hyperMILL function.

tips.title: Define new tool in hyperMILL
tips.body: Switch to the Tools tab, choose New →[Tool type], and define all required parameters with a unique ID.

tips.title: Define a turning tool
tips.body: Right-click on the Tools tab, select New → Tool type, and specify parameters like Tool angle, Tool reference, Cutting edge position.

tips.title: Select a tool in a job
tips.body: Switch to the Jobs tab, create a job, and select the required tool type and defined tool.

tips.title: Define cutting profile parameters
tips.body: Parameters are defined in the external tool database on the Technology dialogue page.

tips.title: Adjust cutting profile values
tips.body: Values can be changed with a factor by selecting the field and entering the required factor.

tips.title: Select a reference tool for rest material areas
tips.body: Choose the reference tool type and ensure it is larger than the machining tool.

tips.title: Define free angle for toolpath calculation
tips.body: Set the minimum angle between the tool insert and the calculated toolpath.

tips.title: Use free tip geometry for collision check
tips.body: Enable the function to use freely defined tool tip for collision checking and simulation.

tips.title: Import tools from external database
tips.body: Select the tool in the browser of the external OPEN MIND tool database and import it into hyperMILL.

tips.title: Export tools to external database
tips.body: Highlight the tool in the hyperMILL browser and choose Export to tool database from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Remove link to external database
tips.body: Unlink the tool from the external database to store changes only in the document database.

tips.title: Restore link to external database
tips.body: Re-link the tool to the external database to recover changes from the external database.

tips.title: Define bounding geometry for stock model creation
tips.body: Use the profile, box/cylinder, or surfaces of the CAD model as the basis for creating a stock model.

tips.title: Set resolution for stock model calculation
tips.body: Specify the maximum permissible distance between the faceted surface of the polyhedron model and the real model surface.

tips.title: Create a cast stock model based on the current CAD model
tips.body: Use the 'Cast offset' option to create a cast stock model that is based on the outer boundary of the loaded model.

tips.title: Select a frame for the turning axis
tips.body: Choose the frame that corresponds to the turning axis of the turning stock, and define any required resolution or offset.

tips.title: Define a stock model based on the stock model of a reference job
tips.body: Use the 'From job' option to define a stock model based on the stock model of a previously defined reference job.

tips.title: Calculate stock model in the job definition
tips.body: On the Setup dialogue page of a job, select the 'Generate resulting stock' option to calculate and store the stock model.

tips.title: Calculate stock model in the browser
tips.body: In the hyperMILL browser, select a job and use the 'Create → stockmodel' function to calculate the stock model.

tips.title: Optimize stock model generation in 5X machining
tips.body: Ensure the Cutting length parameter is defined in the tool definition for optimal stock model generation.

tips.title: Mirror stock models individually or for a job list
tips.body: Use the 'Mirror stock' function to create mirrored versions of individual stock models or all stock models in a job list.

tips.title: Combine multiple stock models into a compound stock
tips.body: Use the 'New compound stock' function to merge multiple stock models into a single compound stock for simultaneous machining.

tips.title: Edit stock to further process resulting stock
tips.body: Select stock model and use Edit Stock function from shortcut menu.

tips.title: Create stock chain for job sequences
tips.body: Select jobs and use Create Stock Chain function from shortcut menu.

tips.title: Structure CAM project using job lists and compound jobs
tips.body: Organize jobs in job lists or use compound jobs for extensive projects.

tips.title: Export job lists for archiving and transfer
tips.body: Select job list, export with options to include tools, geometries, and references.

tips.title: Import job lists into other CAD models
tips.body: Load *.jst file and select import options for tools, geometries, and references.

tips.title: Define job list settings before calculating toolpaths
tips.body: Set joblist name, IDs, origins, and other parameters in Job List Settings.

tips.title: Specify program zero point before creating toolpaths
tips.body: Set NCS (program zero point) before generating toolpaths.

tips.title: Allow multiple origins for machining
tips.body: Enable 'Allow multiple origins' to machine contours on different sides of a part.

tips.title: Activate Best Fit for measuring logs
tips.body: Enable 'Best Fit' to generate a measuring log for further processing with hyperMILL VIRTUAL Machining Center.

tips.title: Define stock model for multiple jobs
tips.body: Set up a stock model in Part Data to be used across multiple jobs.

tips.title: Define milling area for multiple jobs
tips.body: Set up a milling area in Part Data to be used across multiple jobs.

tips.title: Define material for machining purposes
tips.body: Select the required material from the list in Part Data.

tips.title: Define clamping area for job list or new clamping area
tips.body: Set up a clamping area in Fixture Setup.

tips.title: Define fixture parameters for turning jobs
tips.body: Set up fixture parameters such as body length, jaw length, and spindle housing.

tips.title: Define part data including length and orientation
tips.body: Set up part data by defining length and orientation using two points.

tips.title: Define a mirror for all jobs/compound jobs in the job list
tips.body: Select the respective checkbox and choose the required mirror under Selection.

tips.title: Set axial security distance for tool and part in the axial direction
tips.body: Define a value that is considered when optimizing the clearance plane.

tips.title: Calculate the height of the security plane
tips.body: The value should ensure all rotary axes can move without collision.

tips.title: Optimize clearance plane during NC file generation
tips.body: Trims fast travel movements from and to the hyperMILL job clearance plane.

tips.title: Use smooth linking for collision-free movement
tips.body: Optionally, link rapids using a natural movement adapted to machine kinematics.

tips.title: Activate functions for interactive safety
tips.body: Use manually generated 2D or 5X curves to enable collision-free machining.

tips.title: Select profiles for generating collision-free linking movements
tips.body: Choose the appropriate 2D or 5X curves.

tips.title: Define the height of the linking movement
tips.body: Set the height starting from the clamping position.

tips.title: Enable optimized tunnel logic for collision-safe positioning
tips.body: Developed for machines with two rotary axes and Z axis retreat into a tunnel.

tips.title: Enable optimized table logic for collision-safe positioning
tips.body: Available for all machines with two rotary axes in the table.

tips.title: Select machine for NC file creation
tips.body: Click the icon to select or specify a new machine.

tips.title: Set NC directory for saving generated programs
tips.body: Adapt the NC directory to the project directory.

tips.title: Enable document settings
tips.body: Document settings apply to the NC directory for saving generated NC programs.

tips.title: Disable NC directory path definition
tips.body: Click the icon to disable defining the path for the NC directory.

tips.title: Enable NC file naming
tips.body: Enable and select the method for naming NC files (Single mode/Package mode).

tips.title: Define file name variables
tips.body: Available variables: <JLIST>, <JOB>, <JOBID>, <COUNTER>.

tips.title: Set default rapid mode
tips.body: Default: 5X rapid tool movements occur as defined in the cycle.

tips.title: Optimize rapid mode for 5X machining
tips.body: Select 'Optimised' to avoid pole pass and high acceleration of the C axis.

tips.title: Define main spindle/clamp setup
tips.body: Set the coordinate system, lamping setup, name, and comment for the main spindle/clamp.

tips.title: Define counter spindle/clamp setup
tips.body: Set the coordinate system, lamping setup, name, and comment for the counter spindle/clamp.

tips.title: Define local coordinate system (LCS)
tips.body: Create a new LCS or select a previously defined zero point.

tips.title: Define main spindle/clamp reach
tips.body: Select two points: jaw front and part surface point.

tips.title: Define main spindle/clamp Z position
tips.body: Select the contact point on the spindle's contact surface.

tips.title: Define counter spindle/clamp reach
tips.body: Select two points: jaw front and part surface point.

tips.title: Define counter spindle/clamp Z position
tips.body: Select the contact point on the spindle's contact surface.

tips.title: Define turning job frame
tips.body: Edit the standard frame for turning operations in the counterspindle subjob list.

tips.title: Transfer turning model for machining operations
tips.body: Program the transfer of the turning model with main and counter spindle.

tips.title: Enable parting during transfer
tips.body: Allow parting of a long component during transfer from the main spindle to the counter spindle.

tips.title: Activate cleanup tool during transfer
tips.body: Program the cleaning up of the tool during the transfer.

tips.title: Set transfer direction
tips.body: Choose the transfer direction of the component (UseMain to counterspindle or Counter to mainspindle).

tips.title: Define spindle rotation during transfer
tips.body: Programming can take place without spindle rotation (None) or with spindle rotation (Clockwise/Counterclockwise).

tips.title: Set spindle speed for transfer
tips.body: Specify the spindle speed for the transfer with a rotating spindle.

tips.title: Define angle offset for transfer
tips.body: Rotate the clamping jaws by a defined value to ensure safe part transfer.

tips.title: Set transfer position
tips.body: Select a point on the Z axis of the LCS to set a safe transfer position.

tips.title: Define reduced feed rate for transfer
tips.body: Select a point on the Z axis of the LCS from which the counter spindle moves at reduced feedrate.

tips.title: Set reduced feed rate value
tips.body: Define the reduced feedrate for the movement of the counter spindle up to the transfer position.

tips.title: Define safety position for tool transfer
tips.body: Set a safety position (= parking position) for the tool during the transfer of the part.

tips.title: Enable chuck washing during transfer
tips.body: Optionally clean the chuck during the transfer.

tips.title: Define fixed stop during transfer
tips.body: Move to a fixed transfer position or defined contact pressure before closing the spindle.

tips.title: Set working position for counter spindle
tips.body: Use Automatic or Manual to move the counter spindle to a defined value.

tips.title: Create a new job
tips.body: Use the New function on the browser's shortcut menu and specify required settings.

tips.title: Transfer job parameters
tips.body: Use the Copy and Paste functions to transfer parameters between jobs.

tips.title: Define job-specific details
tips.body: Enter a name and comment for the job.

tips.title: Set job IDs
tips.body: Click 'Set job IDs' on the joblist shortcut menu to set new job ID numbers.

tips.title: Generate NC file
tips.body: Enabled by default. An NC file is generated for the cycle if the 'Generate NC file' function is used on the shortcut menu of the job in hyperMILL or in hyperVIEW.

tips.title: Use for additive manufacturing
tips.body: Activate if the cycle is to be used for additive manufacturing.

tips.title: Use name patterns for jobs and comments
tips.body: Proceed as follows: Click the icon to open the 'Define name pattern' dialogue and enable the 'Use pattern' function.

tips.title: Define tool feedback display
tips.body: If the feedback display is activated, the tool, tool holder and tool head are shown by default at the zero point of the WCS or selected frame.

tips.title: Use global colours for toolpath visualisation
tips.body: Set the colours for rapid tool movements (G0) and infeed movements (G1) using global colour definitions from the Setup hyperMILL dialogue.

tips.title: Show NC-Path for specific cycles
tips.body: The Show NC-Path function is available for Thread Milling, Helical Drilling, Pocket Milling, Contour Milling, etc.

tips.title: Define preferred direction for 5-axis machines
tips.body: For machines with 5-axis kinematics, define the preferred spindle orientation in machining situations with at least two solutions.

tips.title: Use global definition for VIRTUAL Machining
tips.body: Enable to use the default settings of the VIRTUAL Machining postprocessor for creating the NC file.

tips.title: Force tool call for multiple jobs
tips.body: If the function is enabled for all jobs, the tool is called from all jobs at the beginning in the postprocessor run.

tips.title: Use NC Optimizer for specific machining situations
tips.body: OPEN MIND recommends using the NC Optimizer for 5-axis machining with rotary axes that do not rotate endlessly, simultaneous applications, machines that cannot move over the table centre, etc.

tips.title: Set maximum rotation angle for G1 movements
tips.body: Specify the maximum permissible rotation angle of the machine axes for G1 movements.

tips.title: Set maximum rotation angle for G0 movements
tips.body: Specify the maximum permissible rotation angle of the machine axes for G0 movements.

tips.title: Define overlap parameters for tool movement
tips.body:
Blending distance factor: 0.5-2.0 (factor of machine tolerance)
Blending length factor: 0.1-0.3 (factor of tool diameter)

tips.title: Optimize infeed movements with NC Optimizer
tips.body: Relink function removes and reconnects original infeed movements as collision-free linear paths on the shortest possible path.

tips.title: Define preset positions for additional axes
tips.body: Additional axes function depends on machine kinematics and requires an appropriate license.

tips.title: Create compound jobs for structured job lists
tips.body: Combine any 2D, 3D or 5X jobs into a compound job for better organization and management.

tips.title: Define linking jobs for optimized machining sequences
tips.body: Linking jobs combine multiple jobs into a single sequence with optimized approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Set conditions for linking movements
tips.body: Use min. distance G0 to execute direct links between pairs of contour points in G1.

tips.title: Configure clearance radius and plane for rapid tool movements
tips.body:
Clearance radius X: 10-20mm
Clearance plane Z: 5-10mm

tips.title: Define retract mode for collision-free movements
tips.body: Retract mode defines the Z level where horizontal infeed movements are executed.

tips.title: Use NC events for structured program flow
tips.body: Create NC events by selecting the event type and entering respective commands.

tips.title: Create associative job copies for parameter synchronization
tips.body: Copy of a job with parameters linked to the original job.

tips.title: Optimize manually created jobs
tips.body: Use the Optimization function on the job list's shortcut menu to group jobs by tool or machining step.

tips.title: Optimize macro jobs
tips.body: Use the Optimization function on the job list's shortcut menu to sort macro jobs by tool sequence or without grouping.

tips.title: Tool sorting in macros
tips.body: Sort tools by ascending or descending diameter within a macro to maintain logical order.

tips.title: Define machining parameters in the Setup input dialogue
tips.body: Set required frame and define job's machining parameters when defining a machining cycle.

tips.title: Explode macro job lists for tool change optimization
tips.body: Expand macro job lists into individual jobs before optimizing tool changes.

tips.title: Edit job definition parameters globally
tips.body: Select multiple jobs and edit common parameters using the Global editing input window.

tips.title: Create new job elements
tips.body: Use the Job... function to open the Select new operation dialogue for creating various job types.

tips.title: Load job data from file
tips.body: Load data of a job or job list that was previously exported using the Export function in .jst format.

tips.title: Apply macros to jobs
tips.body: Open the Apply macros dialogue to apply macros to selected jobs.

tips.title: Replace selected job with another
tips.body: Replace the selected job with another job using the Replace by function.

tips.title: Create stock chain for jobs
tips.body: Select any jobs in a job list or compound jobs to create a stock chain.

tips.title: Calculate toolpath file for selected jobs
tips.body: Update the toolpath file by calculating it based on modified job parameters.

tips.title: Generate NC file for selected entry
tips.body: Perform a postprocessor run to generate an NC file for the selected job or job list.

tips.title: Postprocessor creates link rapids on clearance plane
tips.body: Ensure clearance plane is above all collision-relevant elements.

tips.title: Define transformations in hyperMILL browser
tips.body: Switch to F rames tab, select desired transformation from shortcut menu or create new.

tips.title: Apply transformation to a job
tips.body: Enable Active checkbox, select type of transformation, and choose existing or new transformation.

tips.title: Use linear pattern in a job
tips.body: Define transformation name, comment, direction of pattern, and structure (fixed distance or fit elements).

tips.title: Apply linear pattern to a job
tips.body: Enable Active checkbox, select required linear pattern, specify start and target references.

tips.title: Use circular pattern in a job
tips.body: Define transformation name, comment, axis type, and structure (fit to total angle or fixed step angle).

tips.title: Apply circular pattern to a job
tips.body: Enable Active checkbox, select required circular pattern, specify start and target references.

tips.title: Use general pattern in a job
tips.body: Define transformation name, comment, add target reference system, and change orientation if necessary.

tips.title: Apply general pattern to a job
tips.body: Enable Active checkbox, select required circular pattern, specify start and target references.

tips.title: Mirror mode in hyperMILL
tips.body: Use Mirror path to mirror toolpath without geometry, improves performance but no collision check.

tips.title: Climb milling vs Conventional milling in mirroring
tips.body: For contour machining, choose Left/Right or On contour to ensure geometrically symmetric material removal.

tips.title: Define a transformation for mirroring
tips.body: Navigate to the Transformation dialogue, enter a name and comment if required.

tips.title: Apply a mirror to a job or job list
tips.body: Enable the mirror in the job, compound job, or job list and select the required mirror under Selection.

tips.title: Create a mirrored copy of an element
tips.body: Enable the Copy option to create a mirrored copy that is associatively linked with the original.

tips.title: Remove the link between mirrored parameters and original job
tips.body: Right-click the respective location in the greyed-out dialogue and select Unlink to edit directly.

tips.title: Define a milling area for collision checking
tips.body: Select the Milling area or Turning area in the hyperMILL browser and define the boundaries.

tips.title: Define a fixture area for collision checking
tips.body: Select the surfaces to be used as fixtures and define the colour and layer of the turning contour.

tips.title: Enable wildcard option in filter definition
tips.body: Use the '*' wildcard to search for character strings before or after a placeholder in a layer name.

tips.title: Set minimum tool safe distance for fixture area
tips.body: The minimum distance between the tool and the fixture should not fall below 0.1 mm (0.004 inch). Values between 0.1 mm (0.004 inch) and 0.5 mm (0.02 inch) may lead to long calculation times if collision check is on and stop/clip tolerance is small.

tips.title: Collision check limitations for certain tools
tips.body: A collision check against the defined fixture area is not supported for Chamfered Cutter, T-Slot Cutter, Woodruff Cutter, Barrel Cutter, Turning Tool, Recessing Tool, Axial Recessing Tool and Threading Tool.

tips.title: Define storage location for 3DF files
tips.body: Click the Path button to define the storage location for 3DF files.

tips.title: Set default storage location for 3DF files
tips.body: Set the default storage location in the hyperMILL settings dialogue.

tips.title: Specify resolution for edge curve circle segments
tips.body: Set the maximum chordal height to specify the resolution of edge curve circle segments in G1 lengths.

tips.title: Set surface resolution for 3DF models
tips.body: The surface resolution should be somewhat finer than the dimensional accuracy required in production.

tips.title: Set maximum facet length for 3DF models
tips.body: Controls the maximum facet length within the 3DF model.

tips.title: Select solids or surfaces for conversion in 3DF files
tips.body: Select solids or surfaces to be converted. The same mathematical resolution applies to all selected surfaces/solids.

tips.title: Define group definitions for different resolutions and allowances
tips.body: Select this option if you want to convert areas with different mathematical resolutions and/or different stock allowances.

tips.title: Set mathematical resolution for different groups
tips.body: A coarse resolution is sufficient for roughing areas. A finer resolution should be defined for different fine machining processes.

tips.title: Calculate toolpaths for individual jobs or job lists
tips.body: Either directly in the job definition (for an individual job) or in the hyperMILL browser (for an individual job, multiple jobs or all the jobs in a job list).

tips.title: Recalculate sub-jobs when updating linking jobs
tips.body: If you choose No, only the linking job, and not its sub-jobs, are recalculated.

tips.title: Ignore messages before calculating toolpaths
tips.body: Ignore the messages and calculate the job.

tips.title: Cancel toolpath calculation
tips.body: Select 'Cancel' from the calculation control options.

tips.title: Stop toolpath calculation
tips.body: Select 'Stop' from the calculation control options.

tips.title: Continue toolpath calculation
tips.body: Select 'Continue' from the calculation control options.

tips.title: Delete all toolpaths
tips.body: Use the 'hyperMILL D elete toolpaths' menu or shortcut menu T oolpaths → Delete all.

tips.title: Read toolpaths for a job
tips.body: Select 'Toolpaths → Read' from the shortcut menu of a job list or job.

tips.title: Read any toolpaths for analyses
tips.body: Select 'Read toolpath hyperMILL' from the shortcut menu of a job list or job.

tips.title: Edit toolpaths using boundary
tips.body: Select 'Edit job' from the Mode dropdown in the Parameters dialogue page.

tips.title: Edit toolpaths by splitting based on time
tips.body: Select 'Time' in the Split job dialogue page and define the Tool life (min).

tips.title: Edit toolpaths by splitting based on length
tips.body: Select 'Length' in the Split job dialogue page and define the Tool life in millimetres (inch).

tips.title: Change tolerance factor for splitting
tips.body: Define the permissible deviation of the splitting positions based on the defined tool life.

tips.title: Change mode for splitting toolpaths
tips.body: Select the reason for splitting the toolpath from the Change mode dropdown.

tips.title: Split toolpaths at the end of a machining step
tips.body: Select 'End of path' in the Split mode dropdown.

tips.title: Select toolpath section within a rectangular selection area
tips.body: Use 'Select window' icon to define a rectangular area for selecting toolpaths.

tips.title: Select toolpath section within a polygonal chain area
tips.body: Use 'Select lasso' icon to define an area using a polygonal chain for selecting toolpaths.

tips.title: Select toolpath section within a circular selection area
tips.body: Use 'Select circle' icon to define a circular area for selecting toolpaths.

tips.title: Enter middle point and point on the circumference of a circular selection area
tips.body: In 'Select circle' mode, use C + P to enter the middle point and a point on the circumference.

tips.title: Enter middle point and radius of a circular selection area
tips.body: In 'Select circle' mode, use C + R to enter the middle point and the radius.

tips.title: Select elements arranged in an arc
tips.body: Use 'Select segment' icon to select elements that are arranged in an arc.

tips.title: Select center and vertices of an arc
tips.body: In 'Select segment' mode, select the center with the left mouse button or snap a position, then click two diagonally opposite corners to draw the selection area.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by plane using selected points
tips.body: Use 'Trim by plane' mode and select three non-collinear points to trim the toolpath.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by plane using direction and origin
tips.body: In 'Trim by plane' mode, select a direction and an origin to define the plane for trimming.

tips.title: Untrim toolpath by plane using selected point
tips.body: Select a point in the graphics area for the origin of the plane and use 'Untrim by plane' to remove previous trims.

tips.title: Trim toolpath by curves using selected closed curved line
tips.body: Use 'Trim by curves' mode and select a closed curved line to trim the toolpath.

tips.title: Untrim toolpath by curves using selected closed curved line
tips.body: Use 'Untrim by curves' to remove previous trims based on a selected closed curved line.

tips.title: Invert current selection
tips.body: Use 'Invert selection' to reverse the current toolpath selection.

tips.title: Untrim all previous trims
tips.body: Use 'Untrim all' to remove all previously applied trims from the toolpath.

tips.title: Simulate machining using internal simulation
tips.body: To simulate machining, select the required job and choose 'Internal simulation' from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Simulate machining using internal machine simulation
tips.body: To simulate machining with machine model collision checks, select the required job and choose 'Internal machine simulation' from the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Simulate machining using hyperMILL VIRTUAL Machining Center
tips.body: To simulate machining with collision checks and virtual machine capabilities, use the hyperMILL VIRTUAL Machining Center.

tips.title: Simulate machining using external simulation programs
tips.body: To simulate machining with collision checks and virtual machine capabilities, use external simulation programs like VERICUT.

tips.title: Simulate material removal based on stock model
tips.body: To simulate complete material removal, start the material removal simulation and define the stock and tolerance.

tips.title: Show model defined in joblist during simulation
tips.body: Use 'Show the model defined in the joblist' option to visualize the part being machined during the simulation.

tips.title: Show defined fixture during simulation
tips.body: Use 'Show the defined fixture' option to visualize the fixture being used during the simulation.

tips.title: Create cut through stockmodel at current tool position
tips.body: Use 'Create a cut through the stockmodel at the current tool position' option to visualize the material being removed.

tips.title: Open restmaterial display dialogue during simulation
tips.body: Use 'Open the Restmaterial display dialogue' option to visualize the remaining material after machining.

tips.title: Open measure dialogue during simulation
tips.body: Use 'Open the Measure dialogue' option to perform measurements during the simulation.

tips.title: Decouple simulation window and graphics window
tips.body: Use 'Decouple the simulation window and graphics window' option to separate the simulation view from the CAD model.

tips.title: Use Restmaterial display function for remaining rest material analysis
tips.body: Select job, go to Utilities -> Restmaterial display, define stock model, specify parameters, and view results in color gradient (yellow > green > blue).

tips.title: Define allowance and max rest material for rest material display
tips.body: Allowance: <0.25, second step = < 0.5, third step < 0.75, fourth step > 0.75. Max rest material determines the color blue in the display.

tips.title: Measure distances and angles between surfaces or points
tips.body: Left-click to specify first point, then left-click again for second point. Results include angle, surface distance, and point distance.

tips.title: Enable machine cone shape interpolation for vector jumps
tips.body: Use Enable machine cone shape interpolation option in Machine Structure dialogue for machines with rotary axes.

tips.title: Configure machine components during simulation
tips.body: Open Machine Structure dialogue to specify which components (spindle, table, body) should be displayed during the simulation.

tips.title: Set up collision checks during simulation
tips.body: Open Setup collision check dialogue to specify which elements (tool, holder, model) are checked during the simulation.

tips.title: Enable tool against model collision check
tips.body: Select Tool against model option to consider only the non-cutting part of the tool during collision checks.

tips.title: Enable stock checks during simulation
tips.body: Select Enable stock checks option to check collisions with the stock for tool head, holder, and non-cutting area of tool.

tips.title: Set simulation tolerance and tool mode during setup
tips.body: Specify Simulation tolerance in Setup dialogue, choose Tool mode (Tool from job or Tool from tool list).

tips.title: Configure setup point mode during simulation
tips.body: Select Automatic centre or Manual to specify the setup point for the model in Setup dialogue.

tips.title: Display toolpaths and machine during simulation
tips.body: Enable Display toolpaths and Show machine options in Simulation dialogue to display current toolpath and machine.

tips.title: Switch collision check on during simulation
tips.body: Enable Switches the collision check option in Simulation dialogue to activate collision checks.

tips.title: Use hyperVIEW for collision checks
tips.body: hyperVIEW is a simulation tool based on calculated toolpaths, not NC code-based.

tips.title: Transfer jobs to hyperVIEW
tips.body: Individual jobs or the complete joblist can be transferred from hyperMILL to hyperVIEW.

tips.title: Simulate operations in hyperMILL SIMULATION Center
tips.body: Start simulation by right-clicking on the job or job list and selecting 'Simulation Center'.

tips.title: Use two-window mode for analysis
tips.body: Activate two-window mode by right-clicking and selecting 'Machining simulation' or 'Toolpath preview'.

tips.title: Manage project in hyperMILL SIMULATION Center
tips.body: Project administration includes managing main programs, stock, moving setup, and performing collision checks.

tips.title: Simulate complete NC list
tips.body: In the Program run (Simulation) operating mode, select 'Simulate complete NC list' to simulate all operations.

tips.title: Load specific jobs for simulation
tips.body: Select 'This job only' in the shortcut menu of a main program, tool change job, or operation to limit simulation.

tips.title: Load program
tips.body: Select 'entry in the shortcut menu of the main program' to load a program for run.

tips.title: Show postprocessor log
tips.body: Select 'entry in the shortcut menu of main program, tool change job or operation' to display postprocessor messages.

tips.title: Stop at the end of a program
tips.body: Simulation stops after every main program.

tips.title: Move setup
tips.body: Select 'Move part', 'Move stock', or 'Move fixture' to adjust the setup position.

tips.title: Configure program run view
tips.body: Select 'VNC program file', 'NC program file', 'coordinate values', or 'status messages' in the block display.

tips.title: Simulate toolpath file
tips.body: Set start and end of program run, approach a position with the machine, analyse, start/stop simulation, move axes step-by-step.

tips.title: Collision check and material removal
tips.body: Control collision check and activate stock removal simulation.

tips.title: Set simulation area
tips.body: Select start and end points on the toolpath or use slide controls A and B.

tips.title: Regulate simulation speed
tips.body: Set speeds for rapids (G0) and normal feedrate (G1/2/3), minimum 0.01 mm, maximum 100 mm.

tips.title: Keyboard shortcuts for simulation control
tips.body: Use CTRL+F for full-text search, Back/Forward keys to move one step at a time.

tips.title: Collision check options
tips.body: Specify components to be checked during collision check, tolerance values should be reasonable.

tips.title: Check tool against model
tips.body: Ensure tool matches model for accurate machining.

tips.title: Check holder/shaft/core against model
tips.body: Ensure tool holder, shank, and core match model for accurate machining.

tips.title: Activate rapid traverse check
tips.body: Default is on; can be turned off for certain situations.

tips.title: Check stock during collision check
tips.body: Ensure tool and holder do not collide with stock.

tips.title: Remove detached stock during simulation
tips.body: Automatically remove stock areas with no contact with milling area.

tips.title: Consider core diameter for milling tools
tips.body: Check tool tip collisions with stock, taking core diameter into account.

tips.title: Set tip limit for G0 and G1 movements
tips.body: Limit tool tip contact with model in G0 and G1 movements.

tips.title: Define part allowance for collision check
tips.body: Offset tool shape by entered value during collision check.

tips.title: Use job settings for allowance values
tips.body: Enable to use job-defined values for allowance, allowance XY, and allowance Z.

tips.title: Allow thin shank contact with stock
tips.body: Use tool where shank and cutting edge have same diameter, allowing slight contact.

tips.title: Derive tolerance from stock model resolution
tips.body: Automatically derive collision check tolerance from stock model resolution.

tips.title: Set safety distance to fixture
tips.body: Maintain safe distance between tool and fixture, except for touch probe.

tips.title: Set collision check resolution
tips.body: Adjust accuracy for collision check.

tips.title: Stop on first collision during simulation
tips.body: Program stops at the first collision found during simulation.

tips.title: Display collision information in simulation
tips.body: Show status messages for collisions, gouges, contacts, errors, and warnings.

tips.title: Run to selected position in simulation
tips.body: Move tool to selected position during simulation.

tips.title: Set start and end points for simulation
tips.body: Adjust start and end points for selected job during simulation.

tips.title: Search for coordinates or control commands in program file
tips.body: Find specific blocks containing search string in VNC or NC program file.

tips.title: Save current stock in X format
tips.body: Save the current stock data in *.xformat.

tips.title: Switch rest material display on/off
tips.body: Toggle visibility of rest material during simulation.

tips.title: Control visibility of machine elements in graphics area
tips.body: Manually control display of machine elements, axes, and limits.

tips.title: Manually position machine axes
tips.body: Position linear and rotary axes of the machine for real conditions testing.

tips.title: Display machine axis limits
tips.body: Show limit values of linear and rotary axes for machine coordinate system.

tips.title: Set machine axis limits
tips.body: Displays the limits (Minimum/Maximum) of the linear and rotary axes of the machine.

tips.title: Load tool files
tips.body: Only compatible tool files in the neutral tool exchange format of the tool database can be loaded.

tips.title: Configure simulation settings
tips.body: Set minimum feedrate for rapid movements, number of replay steps, and simulation tolerance.

tips.title: Visualize tool paths
tips.body: Display toolpaths for linking movements, toolpath points, and tool vectors with customizable colors and sizes.

tips.title: Analyze movement paths
tips.body: Perform graphical analysis of the movement paths of linear and rotary axes, insert breakpoints, and display a list of all breakpoints.

tips.title: Write planes/radii on separate layers
tips.body: Use the function in the results list shortcut menu to save radii/planes from analysis on separate layers.

tips.title: Test tool position for optimal machining frame
tips.body: Use the Test tool position function to determine the best frame for a particular type of machining.

tips.title: Setup machine and tool for analysis
tips.body: Click the Tool/Frame line to specify the frame and tool, then select the machine model.

tips.title: Configure setup point mode
tips.body: Use Automatic centre to place the CAD model automatically at the centre of the machine table, or Manual to specify a custom setup point.

tips.title: Align tool at frame or surface normal
tips.body: Use the left mouse button to position the tool anywhere in the CAD model, or align it at the current frame or surface normal.

tips.title: Change tool position based on displayed coordinate system
tips.body: Adjust the tool position based on the current coordinate system using the provided options.

tips.title: Optimise tool length for any tool position
tips.body: hyperMILL calculates the optimum tool length for any specified tool position.

tips.title: Display surface errors during conversion
tips.body: Use the Converter – display surface errors function to identify and view incorrectly converted surfaces.

tips.title: Export geometry data in OMX format
tips.body: Use the Export OMX function to save selected geometry data in a separate *.omxfile.

tips.title: Import TDM Systems tools for data exchange
tips.body: Use the Import TDM Systems tools function to exchange data between TDM Systems and hyperMILL.

tips.title: Import WinTool tools for data exchange
tips.body: Use the Import WinTool tools function to exchange data between WinTool and hyperMILL, automatically assigning NC numbers.

tips.title: Import Zoller tools for data exchange
tips.body: Use the Import Zoller tools function to exchange data between Zoller tool management system and hyperMILL.

tips.title: Contour offset to limit machining areas
tips.body: Use the Contour offset function to change the size of contours and optimize machining areas.

tips.title: Edit contours with specified tolerance and color
tips.body: Select contours to edit, specify the required tolerance value, and choose a new color for the contour.

tips.title: Project contour onto workplane
tips.body: Projects a contour from a CAD model onto the current workplane.

tips.title: Create new contour from existing data
tips.body: Creates a new contour using previously entered data.

tips.title: Link adjacent contours with tolerance
tips.body: Automatically links adjacent contours that do not meet exactly, trimming overlaps and closing gaps within a specified tolerance.

tips.title: Select curves for machining
tips.body: Selects curves that will be machined.

tips.title: Select surfaces for boundary contours
tips.body: Selects surfaces whose boundary contours will be used in subsequent machining.

tips.title: Convert grid to Nurbs curves
tips.body: Converts grids generated in hyperMILL into Nurbs curves for subsequent machining.

tips.title: Recognize external contours of surfaces
tips.body: Recognizes external contours of any number of surfaces based on a specified tolerance.

tips.title: Search for double elements
tips.body: Recognizes any number of double elements based on a specified tolerance.

tips.title: Search for small surfaces
tips.body: Recognizes any number of small surfaces based on a specified minimal area.

tips.title: Extract circles and arcs from contours
tips.body: Extracts circles and arcs from contours for drilling cycles and circular pockets.

tips.title: Convert .3DFF files to STL format
tips.body: Converts .3DFF files into STL format for further processing.

tips.title: Compare two models in CAD
tips.body: Compares two models created in a CAD program, showing changes and options to move or copy changed solid faces.

tips.title: Delete graphical hyperMILL data
tips.body: Deletes all graphical hyperMILL data, such as temporary tool graphics.

tips.title: Thicken planes in CAD model
tips.body: Increases the thickness of selected planes in a CAD model.

tips.title: Export parameter list from CAD model
tips.body: Exports a parameter list from a parametrised CAD model for further changes.

tips.title: Import parameter list into CAD model
tips.body: Imports changes to a parametrised model as a parameter list.

tips.title: Show surfaces with errors in CAD model
tips.body: Shows all surfaces that could not be converted correctly when generating the polyhedron.

tips.title: Hide surfaces with errors in CAD model
tips.body: Hides all surfaces that could not be converted correctly when generating the polyhedron.

tips.title: Clear information about surfaces with errors in CAD model
tips.body: Deletes information about surfaces that could not be converted correctly when generating the polyhedron.

tips.title: Incorrect converted faces in CAD model
tips.body: Shows all incorrectly converted faces and provides options to zoom, hide, show, or delete them.

tips.title: Update model geometry in hyperMILL
tips.body: Transfers changes in the model geometry to hyperMILL for updated CAM operations.

tips.title: Define bottom edge type
tips.body: Options include sharp, fillet, chamfer, corner radius, chamfer angle, and chamfer length.

tips.title: Configure plunge point for drilling
tips.body: Enable the option to use hyperMILL's automatically calculated plunge point for drilling operations.

tips.title: Set boring diameter limit
tips.body: Define the maximum permissible diameter of the tool for drilling operations.

tips.title: Use geometric data for drilling
tips.body: Geometric parameters from the job definition can be automatically copied for use in drilling cycles.

tips.title: Define generic hole parameters
tips.body: Parameters include center, diameter, inner diameter, depth, height inside, inclined angles, and hole position.

tips.title: Use ISO fit parameters for holes
tips.body: Define ISO fit parameters such as designation, diameter, length, and pitch.

tips.title: Define thread parameters for holes
tips.body: Parameters include designation, diameter, length, and pitch.

tips.title: Define spot parameters for holes
tips.body: Parameters include top spot depth and bottom spot depth.

tips.title: Define generic turning feature parameters
tips.body: Parameters include outside profile, plane profile, inside profile, and roughing profiles.

tips.title: Define simple hole parameters
tips.body: Parameters include orientation, group, position, chamfer, chamfer depth, diameter, depth, bottom chamfer, and tip angle.

tips.title: Define sink hole parameters
tips.body: Parameters include orientation, group, position, chamfer, depth, core hole diameter, core hole depth, bottom type, offset bottom, tip angle, ISO fit, and thread.

tips.title: Define free defined hole parameters
tips.body: Parameters include orientation, group, position, ISO fit, ISO fit offset, thread, bottom type, offset bottom, number of steps, step type, diameter, depth, and angle.

tips.title: Define surface parameters
tips.body: Parameters include specifying the surface in the CAD system and defining the strategy type.

tips.title: Define pocket parameters
tips.body: Parameters include specifying the surface in the CAD system and defining the strategy type.

tips.title: Define orientation for pocket milling
tips.body: Enter coordinate values or determine the orientation vector from the CAD system.

tips.title: Specify contour for pocket milling
tips.body: Define contour in the CAD system.

tips.title: Set wall angle for pocket milling
tips.body: Enter angle of pocket wall or derive it from the CAD system.

tips.title: Define Z values for individual contour areas
tips.body: For individual contour areas, it is possible to define different Z values (Top / Depth).

tips.title: Use Compound Feature for complex machining
tips.body: Geometric data from the Compound Feature can be used for 2D, 3D, 5X and drilling cycles in the job definition.

tips.title: Define frame for Compound Feature
tips.body: Frame: Yes if uniform frame required. If this option is selected, only sub features with the same frame system within the Compound Feature are used.

tips.title: Select sub features for Compound Feature
tips.body: Sub features: Select previously defined features.

tips.title: Optimise points for Compound Feature
tips.body: Point optimisation: hyperMILL optimises the paths to be travelled between the holes of the Compound Feature.

tips.title: Reverse sequence for Compound Feature
tips.body: Reverse sequence: Use this function to reverse the machining sequence for the holes in a Compound Feature.

tips.title: Sort holes in Compound Feature
tips.body: Sort Holes: Sort the list of intersecting holes of a Compound Feature in the feature browser.

tips.title: Import and export holes in Compound Feature
tips.body: Import hole / Export hole: Import or export all parameters defined with a hole in*.hmfformat.

tips.title: Define reference frame for exported holes
tips.body: Reference frame: A reference frame can be selected when exporting holes.

tips.title: Use feature lists for imported holes
tips.body: Use feature lists: When importing the holes, you can enable the Use feature list option to preserve the allocation of the Features to the Feature lists.

tips.title: Define blade parameters for turbomachinery feature
tips.body: Under General, specify the required Name for the feature.

tips.title: Select geometric elements for blade feature
tips.body: In the Feature parameters area, select the geometric elements.

tips.title: Define multi-blade parameters
tips.body: Under General, specify the required Name and, if necessary, the Class of the feature.

tips.title: Assign geometry to job parameters
tips.body: Geometry element (CPF) Job parameters: Assign CPF elements to job parameters.

tips.title: Define structure for CPF
tips.body: Define structure: In the hyperMILL browser, switch to the Feature tab and create a new Customised Process Feature.

tips.title: Rename parameters in CPF
tips.body: You can rename the parameters and assign graphics to each parameter.

tips.title: Define filter for CPF
tips.body: To define a filter, click the icon to open the Filter definition dialogue and select the required filter option.

tips.title: Prepare CAD model for CPF
tips.body: For the automatic reading of geometry elements to work correctly, prepare the CAD models according to the filter definition.

tips.title: Link CPF to CAD data
tips.body: To link CAD data of a model to the CPF, proceed as follows: Right-click the feature browser and open the CPF dialogue.

tips.title: Use CPF in job definition
tips.body: To use a CPF in the job definition, switch to the Feature dialogue page and select the corresponding CPF.

tips.title: Reuse CPF in new CAD model
tips.body: To reuse the CPF and the machining sequence with modified CAD data, insert the new CAD model using hyperCAD-S menu File →Merge.

tips.title: Use Feature Mapping (Hole) function for automatic hole assignment
tips.body: Switch to the Feature tab in hyperMILL browser, right-click upper area of feature browser, select Feature Mapping (Hole).

tips.title: Set tolerance for transferring geometric data from CAD model
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under General tab, set Tolerance to specify accuracy level.

tips.title: Enable slot recognition for Feature Mapping (Hole)
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under Options tab, check 'Check slot' to enable slot recognition.

tips.title: Set maximum diameter for feature creation
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under Options tab, check 'Limiting diameter' and set Max. diameter.

tips.title: Use preferred machining direction for hole features
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under Options tab, check 'Use preferred machining direction' and set Offset angle.

tips.title: Check if sinks can be machined from defined direction
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under Options tab, check 'Check sink' to enable the check.

tips.title: Define machining direction for hole features
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under More tab, click icon to select a geometric element or enter vectors manually.

tips.title: Set offset to bottom for through holes
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under More tab, set Offset to bottom.

tips.title: Use feature list for hole assignment
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under More tab, check 'Use feature list' to save holes in existing feature lists.

tips.title: Create associative point for hole features
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under More tab, check 'Create associative point' to display and edit point coordinates.

tips.title: Grouping features with same geometry
tips.body: In Feature Mapping (Hole) dialogue, under More tab, check 'Grouping features' to combine features with the same geometry.

tips.title: Define a sample hole for feature recognition
tips.body: Select a surface of the base hole and all other surfaces are automatically recognised.

tips.title: Use manual definition for feature recognition
tips.body: Select all surfaces of the base hole manually.

tips.title: Set reference feature for creating Generic Holes
tips.body: Select surfaces/points that are to be used to create the hole features.

tips.title: Assign features to an existing feature list
tips.body: Select an existing feature list or create a new one.

tips.title: Filter recognized holes by color
tips.body: Only recognize holes of the same color as the base hole.

tips.title: Filter recognized holes by layer
tips.body: Only recognize holes on the same layer as the base hole.

tips.title: Filter recognized holes by orientation
tips.body: Only recognize holes with the same orientation as the base hole.

tips.title: Set frame limit for hole recognition
tips.body: Define a frame limit (angle) for the recognition process using B axis and C axis.

tips.title: Filter recognized holes by depth
tips.body: Only recognize holes of the same depth as the base hole.

tips.title: Reverse the direction of recognized holes
tips.body: Mark a hole and select the Reverse function in the shortcut menu.

tips.title: Use solid info for drill feature direction
tips.body: If activated, copy the direction of the drill features from the CAD model (solid). If not activated, calculate based on surface information.

tips.title: Recognize pockets with bottoms
tips.body: Ensure the model is a static solid for accurate recognition of pocket bottoms.

tips.title: Combine pockets for more efficient processing
tips.body: Enable Combine pockets to automatically combine individual pockets into a more complex pocket.

tips.title: Suppress chamfers and planes from recognition
tips.body: Exclude planes and chamfers that do not have pocket walls or have been recognised as chamfers.

tips.title: Reduce the number of open pockets recognized
tips.body: Enable Open pocket reduction to use the largest plane by area as the pocket bottom.

tips.title: Manually combine pockets in hyperMILL
tips.body: Highlight pockets in feature browser, select Combine pockets from shortcut menu.

tips.title: Define colours for pocket combination
tips.body: Open Colour table dialogue in Setup hyperMILL, define colours for hub and wall surfaces.

tips.title: Reverse pocket direction manually
tips.body: Double-click list item, right-click and select Reverse or Reverse all for manual direction correction.

tips.title: Create new job for slot milling
tips.body: Use corresponding Pocket feature to create a new job (2D Contour Milling).

tips.title: Define tool diameter for slot milling
tips.body: Specify tool diameter according to slot width and set On contour option.

tips.title: Select active slot profile
tips.body: Select Active only option from shortcut menu of slot profile on Feature dialogue page.

tips.title: Search for pockets in model
tips.body: Select Complete model or User option to search entire model or part of the model.

tips.title: Limit pocket search using filter criteria
tips.body: Define comparison parameters, set conditions for accessibility of pockets, and create feature lists.

tips.title: Limit pocket size using tool diameter
tips.body: Set upper and lower diameter criteria for pocket recognition.

tips.title: Prevent circular pocket recognition
tips.body: Define diameter limitation to prevent holes from being recognized as circular pockets.

tips.title: Set chamfer height and fillet radius
tips.body: Define height of chamfer or radius of fillet between bottom surface and pocket wall.

tips.title: Set chamfer angle limits
tips.body: Define lower and upper limit for chamfer angle between bottom surface and pocket wall.

tips.title: Specify allowed wall types
tips.body: Select Perpendicular option for Z axis of frame defined on Pocket example dialogue page.

tips.title: Suppress original pockets after combination
tips.body: Enable Suppress original pockets option to delete original pockets after combining.

tips.title: Compare sample pocket with pockets to be recognised
tips.body: Define scale limit and comparison tolerance for accurate parameter comparison.
